name: 再现天涯
english_description: Tianya Reborn (in-game banner: 'Dream Return to Tianya'). Unrelated to the Doing-lineage 'Hell' family covered elsewhere in this collection, but shares the same source code as the 'Tianya' family (tybxjh/wlhd/xhcii) — its 'Peak of the World' cliff-jump scene is byte-for-byte identical to theirs, a lineage relationship none of those four archives had previously documented about each other.
